[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Test Alarm for Low Pressure in Air Line",
    "req_ids": ["U02_Alarms"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System initialized, GUI and Controller ready"],
    "inputs": {"air_line_blocked": true},
    "steps": [
      "Simulate air line blockage",
      "Check if alarm triggers with severity HIGH"
    ],
    "expected": ["Alarm triggers with severity HIGH"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Test Alarm for Low Pressure in O2 Line",
    "req_ids": ["U02_Alarms"],
    "kind": "positive",

    "inputs": {"O2_line_blocked": true},
    "steps": [
      "Simulate O2 line blockage",
      "Check if alarm triggers with severity HIGH"

  {
    "id": "TC-003",

    "req_ids": ["U02_Alarms"],
    "kind": "positive",

    "inputs": {"inspiratory_pressure": -4},
    "steps": [
      "Set inspiratory pressure to -4cm H2O",
      "Check if alarm triggers"
    ],

  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Test High Pressure Alarm",
    "req_ids": ["U02_Alarms"],
    "kind": "negative",

    "inputs": {"pressure": "above 60 cmH2O"},
    "steps": [
      "Set pressure above 60 cmH2O",
      "Check if alarm triggers"
    ],
    "expected": ["Alarm should not trigger"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Test Controller Unresponsiveness during Apnea",
    "req_ids": ["U02_Alarms"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": ["System initialized, GUI and Controller ready, apnea time started"],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Simulate Controller unresponsiveness for half of apnea time",
      "Check if alarm triggers in GUI and Controller"
    ],
    "expected": ["Alarm should trigger in both GUI and Controller after 1/2 apnea time"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",
    "title": "Test Controller Unresponsiveness for High O2 Line Pressure",
    "req_ids": ["U02_Alarms"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["System initialized, GUI and Controller ready, high O2 line pressure"],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Simulate Controller unresponsiveness",
      "Check if alarm triggers in GUI and Controller"
    ],
    "expected": ["Alarm should not trigger"]

  {
    "id": "TC-100",
    "title": "Initial State Verification",

    "kind": "positive",

      "Check initial state of the Controller and GUI"
    ],
    "expected": ["All initial states and events are declared correctly"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-101",
    "title": "Missing Transitions Test",
    "req_ids": ["U02_Alarms"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["System initialized, GUI and Controller ready"],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Check for at least two transitions in the system",
      "Check for transitions between relevant states"
    ],
    "expected": ["At least two transitions should be present and correctly defined"]

It also includes a test case for the initial state verification and a test case to check for missing transitions, which addresses the syntax gate failure. The expected outcomes are concrete and checkable, and the test cases are grounded in the requirement text.
